create_html_report: create an HTML report by initializing the HTML class with a web directory and title
add_images_to_html: add a row of images with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML document using add_images
add_videos_to_html: add a row of videos with captions and hyperlinks to the HTML document using add_videos
add_header_to_html: add a text header to the HTML document using the add_header method
save_html_to_disk: save the generated HTML document to an index.html file on disk using save
